name: Labour Force Participation Rate
description: The share of people aged 15 and above who are working or looking for work, by current weekly status. In September 2026 it was 58.0% in rural areas and 50.7% in urban areas.
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, around the 15th, for the previous month.

chart.title: Participation was little changed
chart.subtitle: All-India LFPR, persons 15+, current weekly status, %
chart.source: MoSPI PLFS monthly press note, 15 Oct 2026
